WITH rep_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    e.City,
    c.SupportRepId,
    COUNT(c.CustomerId) as rep_customer_count
  FROM Customer c
  JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
  GROUP BY e.City, c.SupportRepId
),
city_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    City,
    AVG(rep_customer_count) as city_avg
  FROM rep_counts
  GROUP BY City
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    rc.City,
    rc.SupportRepId,
    rc.rep_customer_count,
    cs.city_avg
  FROM rep_counts rc
  JOIN city_stats cs ON rc.City = cs.City
  WHERE rc.rep_customer_count > cs.city_avg
),
total_kept AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(rep_customer_count) as total
  FROM above_avg
)
SELECT 
  aa.City,
  SUM(aa.rep_customer_count) as total_customers_kept,
  AVG(aa.rep_customer_count - aa.city_avg) as avg_excess,
  AVG(aa.rep_customer_count * 1.0 / tk.total) as avg_share
FROM above_avg aa
CROSS JOIN total_kept tk
GROUP BY aa.City
ORDER BY aa.City
